event_name: New York of the 90s: A Loft Kickback
description:
In the low light of the loft, you tap your cigarette out the window, and feel as if you’d been swallowed up into a vision of New York you’d only ever seen on TV. 

A night with a Giuliani twinkle where going out was a kind of athletic event, where the night always ended in dancing and everyone at the bar was a friend, a friend of a friend, or someone famous. 

Wall Street was humming, print was in, magazines were scripture, martinis were cold, and the internet was but a whisper. Its a golden era ruled by Lenny Kravitz, Catherine Zeta-Jones, and Sade.

No social media, no “mutuals,” no iPhones, no Ubers, no Claude, no godamn turn of the century bullshittery. Only sweaty sex with someone you just met.

Take a yellow cab, stay late, wear your best leather.

Would love to celebrate my birthday with all of you with lots of fun and dancing💃🏽💃🏽
Get ready to skip the line & drink a lot since we do have a minimum spend 😝 making up for not celebrating in NY last year 🥳🥳
